commonRules.clock: All examples use elapsed seconds and explicit regular phases repeating every6seconds. Expiry at a START occurs before budget/recharge refresh. No extra-turn clock reset. commonRules.scope: Authored tabletop/deterministic data only. questionRules.R8R-IDENTITY: PRESERVED: four independent identities and every original placement/class-access row in nativeSource. All actual grants here are rank8, minimum class level15, base21 RP, Action,120 feet,V/S/F. Prismatic Wall grants Abjuration to Cleric/Druid/Mage/Wizard; its four unassigned rank9 placements remain unassigned. Faction Convergence and Divine Intervention Lesser grant Divination to Cleric/Wizard. Reality Patch grants Universal to Cleric/Mage/Wizard, not Druid. No generic upcast or expanded class access. Exact original book/core disagreements remain in nativeSource; the supplied Core activation/range/components apply. New interpretations below are scoped only to the named spell. Source records remain unchanged and blocked until a separately authorized canonical application.
questionRules.R8R-AUTHORITY: PRESERVED: exact current735/113 authority supersedes Conference01's525/323. Accepted comparisons retain their own scope and digest; later backing-file edits are not accepted merely by resemblance. Original gods/planes assertions remain evidence, not deity statistics, automatic divine rescue, creature classification or current campaign epoch. Seven-member Choir and public theology remain distinct; no Fifteenfold-name-to-Choir mapping. Current accepted Null, death, casting, timing, control and body interfaces apply exactly. Retain GP-U01..17 and all inherited qualifications; GP-U15's historical pending label does not reopen now-applied EPI mechanics. Missing ancestor receipts/drafts are retained as provenance limitations, never executed or substituted for the exact operative records supplied.
questionRules.R8R-FACTION-QUERY: NEW: select a finite set of at least two actually known institution identities, one concrete scenario and a24-elapsed-hour forecast horizon from resolution. For each selected institution identify one perceived current member within120 feet and line of effect as a local reference; these references do not limit the geographic reach of the institution's relevant activities. Distinct institutions cannot be fabricated by aliases. Fix the full selection before payment. Known missing references/duplicate-only selection fail preflight. Actual hidden nonmembership, undefined identity or wholly protected reference defeats the paid query as a whole with no membership/existence diagnosis or refund. This local-reference rule belongs only to Convergence, not to Faction Divination or another accepted query. Membership, action IDs and current plans require real source records or explicitly NEW conditional scene content; missing campaign facts stay held.
questionRules.R8R-FACTION-FORECAST: NEW: take one finite snapshot of actual current orders, commitments, resources, routes and physical dependencies relevant to the selected scenario during the horizon. Return every readable causal interaction between the selected institutions' in-scope actions, including support, obstruction, competition and enabling, with its actual premise, timing and resulting consequence. No arbitrary sample or strongest-N cut. Existing fixed orders may support a consequence conditional on continued execution; future voluntary choices remain explicit alternatives only where the actual decision/options are defined. Unknown future choices/facts remain indeterminate, not invented prophecy or a fabricated extra branch. Remote institutional activity is eligible; this grants information, not remote senses, targeting, faction control, membership, standing or reputation change.
questionRules.R8R-FACTION-PROTECTION: PRESERVED/NEW local projection: the query is actual rank8 Divination. Evaluate each premise, subject, site and output field against each real protection's generating-rank/classification/scope. Protection from Scrying has no rank ceiling and blocks new information about its actual recipient even here. Facts with independent unprotected institutional evidence remain readable. Remove existence-protected actions altogether with no placeholders, counts, identifiers, timing gaps, hashes or ordering side channel. For a row independently known to exist, a blocked requested field may be simply indeterminate; never identify the ward, protected subject or reason. Do not reconstruct protected facts by subtracting factions or comparing casts. The player's report and its stable identifier derive only from the permitted projection, never from hidden-state hashes. Director-only source truth and hashes are separately labelled private.
questionRules.R8R-FACTION-STABILITY: NEW: canonical institution/action/decision IDs and normalized scenario, references, horizon-relevant events and permitted information determine the result. Cosmetic wording, aliases, different eligible casters and repeated queries over the same material state do not select new facts or reroll. Moving the24-hour window changes output only when actual relevant events enter/leave or their material facts/choices change. A new real decision changes its conditional consequences; it does not retroactively edit the earlier report. Private-only changes leave the public projection and public report ID unchanged. No caster-keyed hidden-data rotation.
questionRules.R8R-FACTION-PRESENTATION: NEW: instantaneous private navigable report, organized by the actual selected institutions, readable action IDs and causal dependencies. Retain the complete permitted finite graph and all defined conditional alternatives. Receiving it is not instant comprehension of every page and grants no extra Action, Reaction, reading or communication time. The caster may later inspect the remembered snapshot using ordinary attention/time; written or spoken disclosure uses ordinary means. The spell supplies no live updates, autonomous advice or new fact on reopening a report. Loss of later access does not erase already learned information; suppression at resolution prevents delivery with no queued catch-up, while later suppression does not erase memory. Forecast accuracy is conditional on the supplied current state, not a balance/cosmology guarantee.
